title: [Main] - Bug 657870: [ExpenseAgent] Allow assigning interim approvers via API before expense reports are pending approval
summary: Interim approvers can now be assigned via API before an expense report is submitted for approval, allowing them to be configured on Released reports without changing the active approver.
key_points: Interim approver assignment enabled on Released and Pending Approval reports, not just Pending Approval
On Released reports, interim approver is saved without changing report status or active approver until submission
Conflicts revalidated when routing on submit, resubmit, or reopen to prevent interim approver from being final approver
Assignment remains blocked on Open, Interim Approved, and Approved reports with updated error messages
Added comprehensive regression tests for pre-submission assignment, two-stage approval flow, and validation scenarios
quote: Allow interim approver assignment on Released and Pending Approval reports through a shared status check.
